name: Pestilence
description: Shots [dark-red]plague[/dark-red] enemies for 8 seconds, stacking 3 times. [dark-red]Plagued[/dark-red] enemies have [effect:wither][dark-gray]Wither I-III[/dark-gray][/effect] and spread the [dark-red]plague[/dark-red] to the nearest [effect:enemies][dark-gray]1-3 enemies[/dark-gray][/effect] within 8 blocks on death.

effects.explanation: Number of spreads equals Plague stacks.
